'''Sportverein Lafnitz''' (commonly known as '''SV Licht-Loidl Lafnitz''' for sponsorship purposes) is an [[Football in Austria|Austrian association football]] club from [[Lafnitz]]. They currently play in the [[Austrian Regionalliga South]] and play their home games at the ''Sportplatz Lafnitz'' in [[Lafnitz]]."}}
